notes.title: Patch note V1.61 - Various bug fixes & new graphic options!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043211/a9e4f04d3db85482d1398f0502c331c8fca24e89.jpg[/img]

AWAY's first patch is now available on PC! We've fixed some bugs reported by the community & also have added new graphic options in the menu. Here's a list of what changed in this patch:

- Steam Achievements now works as intended
- FOV is now adjustable in the graphic settings
- Smoothing has been removed when you play with a mouse & keyboard
- Mouse controls have been reworked & feel more pleasant
- Bugfix of the below ground enemies
- New graphic settings have been added for the PCs with low performances
- Various new settings in the menu
- Various minor bug fixes

If you still encounter bugs while playing, please go on the Steam forums & write a summary of what is happening, ideally with screenshots / video capture of the issue.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043211/6c8f5a59035fa2dea315abccb68b330a50810d20.png[/img]

We'll continue to share infos about the game on social media, so feel free to follow us here to stay updated on Away news:
